named_targets.story: Three merchants have disappeared over the past two weeks. Their bodies were eventually discovered along the old canal, each bearing a single red cut across the throat. Witnesses describe a man wearing a dark travelling coat who asks merchants about their family before following them. The authorities believe Elias Vane is responsible for at least six murders. Yesterday, a dockworker survived an encounter with him and reported seeing supernatural abilities. The guild has been offered a substantial reward for his capture.

Several disappearances have been linked to a woman who leaves black mirrors at the scene. Survivors report charms, poison and impossible reflections. The guild is asked to bring her in before another district is affected.

A string of impossible thefts has left locked rooms empty without signs of entry. Witnesses describe a man who seems to make attacks and doors behave incorrectly. The authorities suspect supernatural interference.

contracts: Mrs. Eliza Bell, a seamstress in Whitechapel, arrives at the guild office in tears. Her black cat, Morrow, vanished before dawn. She cannot afford a private detective and asks the guild to search the alleys, courtyards and coal sheds nearby. The cat is frightened, not dangerous; this is a search and rescue contract.
A respectable family claims a silver locket was stolen from a locked room. The owner suspects a servant, but the room shows signs of something stranger.
A local constable asks the guild to discreetly investigate a murder before panic spreads. The victim's final note mentions a person who should not have been there.
Residents of a boarding house report knocking from an empty room every midnight. The landlord wants the matter solved quietly.
A night watchman disappeared while patrolling a quiet street. His lantern was found still burning beside a locked iron gate.
A charitable chapel reports strange chanting beneath its foundations. The priest insists there is no basement, yet a staircase was discovered after midnight.
Several merchants received identical anonymous invoices for goods they never ordered. Those who ignored them later disappeared.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Red Knife
WANTED_TARGETS.story: Elias once escorted dockworkers home through the fog. When the canal syndicate abandoned his brother after an accident, he turned that duty into a private war. Merchants now vanish along the towpath, marked with the same red cut. He has learned to provoke a crowd into fighting itself. Three agents must corner him before another shift ends.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: Below half health, his frenzy grants a second action and 15% more damage. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt. Ongoing damage affects this target at 35% strength. The target's ongoing damage deals 20% of its usual damage.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Black Mirror
WANTED_TARGETS.story: A celebrated portrait restorer, Mara promised grieving families one final glimpse of the dead. Her black mirrors began keeping those families instead. She now moves between abandoned shop windows while poison spreads through their rooms. The guild has traced every mirror to her workshop; three agents are needed to break the escape routes and face her together.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: At half health, she raises a shield worth 25% of maximum HP and deals 15% more damage. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt. Her lingering poison deals 35% less damage than an ordinary application. Ongoing damage affects this target at 50% strength. Misdirection and friendly fire deal 25% of their usual damage during this hunt. The target's ongoing damage deals 25% of its usual damage.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Broken Hour
WANTED_TARGETS.story: Jonas repaired the district clocks until a guild patron erased his name from the commission ledger. Now the clocks lose an hour whenever he steals, and witnesses cannot agree which doors were open. His stolen records hold entire households in debt. A three-agent warrant team must force him into the same moment long enough to end the thefts.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: At half health, he drains 15% of each agent’s maximum SP and deals 20% more damage. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt. Redirected strikes deal 25% of their usual damage to the party. Ongoing damage affects this target at 35% strength. Misdirection and friendly fire deal 25% of their usual damage during this hunt. The target's ongoing damage deals 50% of its usual damage.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Ashen Choir
WANTED_TARGETS.story: Agatha kept vigil over patients no physician could save. She found a hymn that eased their fear, but the choir it awakened never stopped singing. The hospice now sleeps through every sunrise and its lost patients walk in shared dreams. Three agents must enter the vigil, protect one another from its lullaby, and bring the waking bell back to the ward.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: At half health, her nightmare frightens every agent for one turn and increases damage by 20%. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt. Ongoing damage affects this target at 85% strength.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Vacant Crown
WANTED_TARGETS.story: Voss bought the courts that stripped his family of its title. He then changed the meaning of every oath sworn inside them. Petitioners arrive seeking justice and leave owing him their names. His vacant crown still commands guards who no longer remember him. A three-agent party must withstand the court’s decrees and break his authority together.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: At half health, his decree drains 20% of maximum SP from every agent and increases damage by 20%. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt.

WANTED_TARGETS.title: The Last Hour
WANTED_TARGETS.story: Ione catalogued disasters that had not happened yet. When she tried to spare the city its final calamity, she bound herself to an hour that never arrives. The observatory now repeats the deaths of everyone who crosses its threshold. Three agents must share the burden of that hour and confront its keeper before the city becomes another entry.
WANTED_TARGETS.mechanic: At half health, she gains a second action and a shield worth 20% of maximum HP. The party has 50 rounds to finish the hunt. Ongoing damage affects this target at 35% strength.

campaign.title: The Whispering District
campaign.subtitle: Chapter I · A first case for your guild
campaign.intro: People vanish after hearing a bell that the district insists has not rung in thirty years. Archivist Mara Venn asks your new guild to find them before the next midnight.

npc.name: Mara Venn
npc.line: Bring them home. We can argue about what the bell means afterward.

campaign.threat: The Hushed Choir, an occult society led by Cantor Vale

missions.title: Open the Guild Doors
missions.brief: Put one prepared Beyonder on the case.
missions.story: Mara leaves a missing-person ledger on your desk. Recruit an agent, awaken them to a pathway of your choice, then equip a weapon before accepting her commission. Agents already in your guild count.
missions.objective: Have at least one active, awakened agent with a weapon equipped.
missions.successText: Your agent signs the ledger. Mara marks three disappearances around the shuttered bell house and pays the first part of your commission.

missions.title: Follow the Whispers
missions.brief: Choose which lead to follow through the district.
missions.story: A lamplighter remembers people following a silent procession. Meanwhile, the old bell-house accounts list deliveries to a cellar that should be empty. Both leads can reveal how the Choir operates.
missions.objective: Choose a lead and secure a useful clue. This investigation has no combat.

choices.label: Interview the lamplighter
choices.description: Ask residents to reconstruct the procession and its chant.
choices.benefit: The counter-chant weakens Vale's attacks by 15% in the final confrontation.
choices.outcome: The lamplighter repeats the chant with one missing note. Mara recognizes a counter-chant that will interrupt Vale's rhythm.

choices.label: Trace the bell-house ledger
choices.description: Follow the deliveries and locate the Choir's ritual anchor.
choices.benefit: Breaking the hidden anchor reduces Vale's health by 15% in the final confrontation.
choices.outcome: The deliveries lead to a clay resonance jar beneath the bell house. Marking its seal reveals the weak point sustaining Vale's ritual.

missions.successText: A symbol in the evidence identifies the Hushed Choir. The missing residents are being held beneath the old bell house, and their captor is a Sleepless called Cantor Vale.

missions.title: Prepare for the Last Bell
missions.brief: Turn the evidence into a plan for the confrontation.
missions.story: Mara opens the district's emergency stores. There is enough time to prepare either a protective bell seal or a field reserve. Your chosen support is free and applies only to this chapter's boss battle.
missions.objective: Choose your support. You may bring one to three agents to the confrontation.

choices.label: Prepare a silencing seal
choices.description: Bind the bell's resonance before the fight begins.
choices.benefit: Vale's ATK and INT are reduced by another 25% for this chapter battle.
choices.outcome: Mara folds wax and copper into a seal. At the bell house, it will absorb the first echoes and leave Vale's attacks weakened.

choices.label: Pack a field reserve
choices.description: Supply the party with protective gear and a measured restorative.
choices.benefit: All deployed agents gain 25% maximum HP and 15% ATK and INT for this chapter battle.
choices.outcome: Your agents pack reinforced coats and measured restoratives. The reserve will improve their endurance and damage during the confrontation.

missions.successText: The cellar entrance is found and an escape route is secured. No extra purchase or advancement is required: a rested, equipped Sequence 9 party can attempt the case.

missions.title: Silence the Hushed Choir
missions.brief: Confront Cantor Vale and free the missing residents.
missions.story: Below the bell house, Cantor Vale conducts a procession around a sealed, stolen bell. Its echoes keep the captives moving in circles. Your evidence and preparations weaken the rite before the agents close in.
missions.objective: Defeat Cantor Vale, a Sequence 9 Sleepless of the Darkness pathway.
missions.successText: Vale falls and the sealed bell goes silent. The missing residents wake from the procession. Your agents escort them up the cellar steps while Mara takes custody of the bell.
missions.failureText: The escape route holds. Mara's district wardens recover every agent, restore their strength and secure the entrance. The case remains open: retry without losing agents, funds, materials or chapter progress.

missions.title: Daybreak in the District
missions.brief: Close the case and collect the guild's commission.
missions.story: The residents return home. The bell is sealed in the district archive, and Mara invites your agents to record what they learned. Your guild has its first completed case.
missions.objective: File the report and receive the Whispering District case-file badge.
missions.successText: Case closed: The Whispering District. Your commission, pathway materials and potion digestion prepare the guild for Sequence 8. Supernatural contracts remain available to finish digestion and earn further supplies.

wardbreaker.name: Wardbreaker
wardbreaker.benefit: Breaking an enemy shield restores {refundSP}% Max SP; once per round.

vengeful_echo.name: Vengeful Echo
vengeful_echo.benefit: Enemy HP damage empowers your next damaging action by {damageBonus}%; once per round, no stacking.

runic_carapace.name: Runic Carapace
runic_carapace.benefit: Completing a paid pathway skill grants a {shieldHP}% Max HP shield; once per round.

cinder_touch.name: Cinder Touch
cinder_touch.benefit: Basic HP hits have a {chance}% chance to apply Burn for {turns} target turns; one attempt per round.

nerve_pin.name: Nerve Pin
nerve_pin.benefit: A critical hit slows its primary target by {slow}% for {turns} target turns; once per round.

merciful_touch.name: Merciful Touch
merciful_touch.benefit: Restoring a teammate’s HP also cleanses one damage-over-time status; once per round.

spiteful_shell.name: Spiteful Shell
spiteful_shell.benefit: An enemy breaking your shield triggers physical retaliation worth {retaliationHP}% Max HP; once per round.

break_the_chain.name: Break the Chain
break_the_chain.benefit: After losing an action to crowd control, cleanse one remaining action-blocking status; once per round.

hunters_opening.name: Hunter's Opening
hunters_opening.benefit: Your first attempted basic attack against each full-HP enemy critically hits if it connects; forced failure still applies.

fractured_moment.name: Fractured Moment
fractured_moment.benefit: After your first successful damaging normal action, take one bonus action; once per battle.

fates_debt.name: Fate's Debt
fates_debt.benefit: Survive one otherwise lethal direct enemy hit at 1 HP; once per battle, excluding executions.
fates_debt.drawback: Lose all SP; healing is blocked through the end of your next scheduled turn.

martyrs_mantle.name: Martyr's Mantle
martyrs_mantle.benefit: Redirect {share}% of teammates’ direct HP damage to yourself, capped at {roundCap}% of your Max HP per round.
martyrs_mantle.drawback: Transferred damage bypasses your defenses and can kill you.

blood_script.name: Blood Script
blood_script.benefit: Paid pathway skills spend HP instead of SP: {hpCost}% Max HP × normal SP cost / Max SP.
blood_script.drawback: Casting must leave at least 1 HP; cooldowns and unlocks still apply.

hollow_saint.name: Hollow Saint
hollow_saint.benefit: All healing you produce becomes shields at {conversion}% value, capped at {roundCap}% recipient Max HP per round.
hollow_saint.drawback: Your healing cannot restore HP; resurrection is unchanged.

unbroken_will.name: Unbroken Will
unbroken_will.benefit: Spend {controlCost}% Max SP to act through Stun, Freeze, Bound, Sleep or Polymorph for this scheduled turn.
unbroken_will.drawback: Insufficient SP leaves control in force; banishment and Madness are unchanged.

lone_sovereign.name: Lone Sovereign
lone_sovereign.benefit: When originally deployed alone, take two normal actions per scheduled turn.
lone_sovereign.drawback: A teammate removes the extra action; becoming the last survivor does not activate it.

unbound_canticle.name: Unbound Canticle
unbound_canticle.benefit: Paid single-target damaging pathway skills hit all eligible foes for {damage}% damage each; utility stays on the primary target.
unbound_canticle.drawback: Converted skills cost {surcharge}% more SP and lose damage against a lone enemy.

spell_eater.name: Spell Eater
spell_eater.benefit: Basic hits burn {drain}% enemy Max SP and heal from actual SP removed, capped at {healCap}% of your Max HP per round.
spell_eater.drawback: Active pathway skills are disabled; zero-SP targets give no drain healing.

chronal_engine.name: Chronal Engine
chronal_engine.benefit: Eligible damaging skills can be reused while cooling down; each remaining turn adds {surcharge}% SP cost.
chronal_engine.drawback: Control, execution, copying, revival, extra-action and signature skills keep normal cooldowns.

spirit_bastion.name: Spirit Bastion
spirit_bastion.benefit: SP absorbs direct enemy HP damage; a full SP pool absorbs {absorption}% Max HP.
spirit_bastion.drawback: Casting spends the same protection resource; executions and indirect damage are excluded.
